nodes.label: NOTE: the wheel intentionally runs up to the current year so it opens on it.
nodes.norm_label: note: the wheel intentionally runs up to the current year so it opens on it.

nodes.label: Aurora Sheet Design System
nodes.rationale: Teal-to-blue gradient header with a white rounded sheet overlapping it; locked so screens read as one continuous surface.

nodes.label: Auth Fallback Chain
nodes.rationale: Google Sign-In primary, Email OTP fallback, Twilio SMS secondary, WhatsApp deferred pending Meta Business approval.

nodes.label: signup_verified Gate
nodes.rationale: App-level flag that closes the route around signup OTP: an account that abandoned OTP and completed password recovery looks confirmed to GoTrue, so Supabase's own state cannot be trusted as proof of signup.

nodes.label: One Screen Per File Rule
nodes.rationale: main.dart stays entry point plus routing only, so screens never accumulate there.

nodes.label: Password Policy: 8 Chars, No Composition Rule
nodes.rationale: Minimum 8 characters with no character-type requirement; letters-only, numbers-only, or any mix all valid.
nodes.norm_label: password policy: 8 chars, no composition rule

nodes.label: Graphify Skill Trigger
nodes.rationale: Project-local instruction routing /graphify to the installed skill before any other handling.

nodes.label: Password Reset Web Page
nodes.rationale: Hosted outside the app so a recovery link opens in a browser; mirrors the Aurora sheet visual language in plain HTML/CSS.

nodes.label: showScreen
nodes.rationale: Single-active-screen state machine over four state divs. Iterating a map that held a lookup for a deleted screen made it throw on null.classList and strand the page on the spinner.

nodes.label: screens Element Map
nodes.rationale: Must stay in sync with the markup: every key needs a real element or showScreen degrades.

nodes.label: showFatalError
nodes.rationale: Global last-resort surface wired to window error and unhandledrejection. Touches the DOM directly so it stays callable before later const declarations exist.

nodes.label: mapUpdatePasswordError
nodes.rationale: Maps GoTrue error_code to Arabic copy; raw English server text never reaches the screen.

nodes.label: ERROR_CODE_MESSAGES
nodes.rationale: Keyed on GoTrue error_code: same_password and weak_password.

nodes.label: Password Visibility Toggle
nodes.rationale: Swaps between an open eye and a slashed eye via a revealed class, because flipping input.type alone left the icon static.

nodes.label: Recovery Token Verification
nodes.rationale: verifyOtp with type recovery, run from JS on load so email scanners that only prefetch HTML cannot burn the token. Confirms the account's email as a server-side side effect.

nodes.label: JS-Execution Scanner Defense
nodes.rationale: Requiring real script execution rather than an HTTP GET is what stops email security scanners from consuming single-use recovery links.

nodes.label: Google G Logo Mark
nodes.rationale: Four-path Google G in official brand colors, used on the Google Sign-In button.
